title: test_dodag.py: Test does not exercise claimed feature (max_rank_increase)
description: test_max_rank_increase_rejects_distant_parent (line 148) uses dio.rank=2305, but by that point node.rank=512. The implementation at dodag.py:211 checks `if self.rank != INFINITE_RANK and dio.rank >= self.rank: return`, which fires (2305 >= 512) and rejects the candidate BEFORE the max_rank_increase logic is reached. The test passes for the wrong reason and the max_rank_increase feature remains untested. To actually test max_rank_increase, use a low dio.rank (e.g., 300) with high link_etx (e.g., 10.0) so the candidate passes the rank check but has path_cost (300 + 2560 = 2860) exceeding the limit (512 + 2048 = 2560).
close_reason: Rewrote test_max_rank_increase_rejects_distant_parent to hit MaxRankIncrease: join rank 256 etx 1.0 (cost 512), then candidate rank 256 etx 10.0 (cost 2816 > 512+2048) with DAGRank 1 < 2. Independent oracle path_cost = rank + round(etx * 256). File: python/tests/rpl/test_dodag.py. Verified: uv run pytest tests/rpl/test_dodag.py tests/rpl/test_dao.py — passed.
